arxiv-2212-02990.title: Sub-µm axial precision depth imaging with entangled two-colour Hong-Ou-Mandel microscopy
arxiv-2212-02990.creator: Cyril Torre 1,2 , Alex McMillan 1 , Jorge Monroy-Ruz 1 and Jonathan C.F. Matthews 1
arxiv-2212-02990.description: Abstract The quantum interference of two wavelength-entangled photons overlapping at a beamsplitter results in an oscillating interference pattern. The frequency of the beat note is dependent on the wavelength separation of the entangled photons but is robust to wavelength scale perturbations that can limit the practicality of standard interferometry.

arxiv-2302-00635.title: Shared SAT Solvers and SAT Memory in Distributed Business Applications
arxiv-2302-00635.creator: Sergejs Kozlovičs
arxiv-2302-00635.description: Abstract We propose a software architecture where SAT solvers act as a shared network resource for distributed business applications. There can be multiple parallel SAT solvers running either on dedicated hardware (a multi-processor system or a system with a specific GPU) or in the cloud.

arxiv-2308-08053.title: Natural Evolution Strategies as a Black Box Estimator for Stochastic Variational Inference
arxiv-2308-08053.creator: Ahmad Ayaz Amin ahmadayaz.amin@torontomu.ca
arxiv-2308-08053.description: Abstract Stochastic variational inference and its derivatives in the form of variational autoencoders enjoy the ability to perform Bayesian inference on large datasets in an efficient manner. However, performing inference with a VAE requires a certain design choice (i.e. reparameterization trick) to allow unbiased and low variance gradient estimation, restricting the types of models that can be created.

arxiv-2601-02921.title: Ramaswami Type translation formulae for the polylogarithm functions

arxiv-2601-02921.description: Abstract . In 1934, Ramaswami proved a number of curious translation formulae satisfied by the Riemann zeta function. pmc-12876978.description: In situ high-resolution structure determination is limited to samples thin enough to be penetrated by the electron beam during imaging. However, surface damage caused by the milling process can extend 30-60 nm deep, restricting the usable lamella thickness.

pmc-13490584.description: The functionalization of nanocellulose (NC) to enhance its effect on UF resin properties and wood-based materials still remains insufficiently explored. uslaw-usc-t10-s1440.title: 10 U.S.C. § 1440 — Annuities not subject to legal process
uslaw-usc-t10-s1440.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s1440.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 73 (Annuities Based On Retired Or Retainer Pay); Subchapter I (Retired Serviceman’S Family Protection Plan). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Except as provided in section 1437(c)(3)(B) of this title, no annuity payable under this subchapter is assignable or subject to execution, levy, attachment, garnishment, or other legal process.

uslaw-usc-t28-s334.title: 28 U.S.C. § 334 — Institutes and joint councils on sentencing
uslaw-usc-t28-s334.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s334.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part I (Organization Of Courts); Chapter 15 (Conferences And Councils Of Judges). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In the interest of uniformity in sentencing procedures, there is hereby authorized to be established under the auspices of the Judicial Conference of the United States, institutes and joint councils on sentencing. The Attorney General.

uslaw-usc-t36-s152308.title: 36 U.S.C. § 152308 — Principal office
uslaw-usc-t36-s152308.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s152308.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1523 (National Music Council). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The principal office of the corporation shall be at the place the board of directors decides. However, the activities of the corporation may be conducted throughout the States, territories, and possessions of the United States.
